about: Reviewed starting inputs for the font-gpos target. The first byte picks the kerning format (value modulo 3: GPOS pairs by glyph, by class, or a kern table) and, for classes, the class counts (2 to 4 first classes by the byte shifted right 2, modulo 3; 1 to 4 second classes by bits 4 and 5). Each further byte (up to 32) chooses the pairs of one first glyph and the text. The font is built from 2 and 16 copies of the first glyphs.
